name: Linear
description: Linear is a product development system combining issue tracking, planning, and AI agent collaboration, built for modern workflows involving both human developers and AI agents.
best_for: Positioned for teams and enterprises combining human development practices with AI workflows, from startups to major enterprises, seeking to increase velocity while reducing operational noise.
features: AI-powered agent integration from PRD drafting to deployment
Intake automation converting feedback into prioritized issues
Code review and diff analysis for human and agent changes
Analytics and dashboards for monitoring progress across teams
Coding session review on mobile and desktop

alternatives.name: Jira
alternatives.description: Atlassian issue and project tracking software for enterprise agile teams.
alternatives.best_for: Large organizations requiring extensive workflow customization and enterprise compliance

alternatives.name: ClickUp
alternatives.description: All-in-one project management and productivity platform with sprint tracking.
alternatives.best_for: Cross-functional teams wanting sprint management alongside docs and chat

alternatives.name: Monday.com
alternatives.description: Visual work management platform with cross-departmental roadmap collaboration.
alternatives.best_for: Connecting engineering cycles to broader marketing and executive roadmaps

alternatives.name: Zoho Projects
alternatives.description: An online project management platform for planning, tracking, and collaborating on work, with deep integration into the wider Zoho suite.
alternatives.best_for: Teams already using Zoho apps, and organizations wanting an affordable, feature-rich project tool

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Unlimited members, 2 teams, 250 issues, and the agent platform.

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.notes: $10/user/month billed yearly; 5 teams, unlimited issues and file uploads, and admin roles.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: $16/user/month billed yearly; unlimited teams, private teams and guests, Insights, Triage Intelligence, Loops, and additional integrations.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom annual pricing; adds SAML/SCIM, granular administration, enterprise security, migration/onboarding, and priority support.

cons: The Free plan is limited to 2 teams and 250 issues; unlimited issues require Basic or higher.
Basic is limited to 5 teams; private teams, guests, and several advanced intelligence/analytics features require Business.
Some AI and agent workflow capabilities require separate AI credits even on paid plans.
